## Personality

Jane Andrews is known for being sensible, unflappable, and conscientious in her pursuits, earning domestic science honors through her steady, plain nature. She intends to dedicate her life entirely to teaching rather than marriage, driven by the practical benefit of earning a guaranteed salary.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## History

Jane Andrews travelled to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) alongside [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Billy](../character/billy.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for Anne's recital performance. On the ride home after the event, Jane and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) exchanged compliments and voiced their envy of the wealthy hotel guests. Later, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) moved to town to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), Jane visited her at her boarding house along with [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) and Ruby, helping to ease Anne's intense homesickness on her first day.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P38](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P43](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0043), +5 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane-andrews.md)

Jane and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) share a long-standing friendship that originated during their school days. They participate in group activities together, such as school outings, plays, and advanced study groups for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy). Jane also travels with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to events, including riding to and from the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for Anne's recital.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P17](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), +6 more_
